tips.en: Sip water through the day: nimbu-pani, chaach and coconut water help too.
tips.hinglish: Din bhar thoda-thoda paani piyein: nimbu-pani, chaach aur nariyal paani bhi achhe hain.

tips.en: Try to stay indoors between 12 and 4 PM when the loo is strong.
tips.hinglish: Dopahar 12 se 4 baje tak, jab loo chalti hai, ghar ke andar rahein.

tips.en: Keep ORS at home. If you feel dizzy or very tired, rest in the shade and drink fluids.
tips.hinglish: Ghar mein ORS rakhein. Chakkar ya thakaan lage to chhaanv mein aaraam karein aur paani piyein.

tips.en: Wear loose cotton clothes and cover your head when you step out.
tips.hinglish: Dheele soot ke kapde pehnein aur bahar jaate samay sir dhakein.

tips.en: Drink boiled or filtered water, and wash fruit and vegetables well.
tips.hinglish: Ubla ya filter kiya paani piyein, aur phal-sabzi achhi tarah dhoyein.

tips.en: Keep mosquitoes away: nets, full sleeves, and no standing water near the house.
tips.hinglish: Machhar door rakhein: machhardaani, poori baanh ke kapde, aur ghar ke paas paani jama na hone dein.

tips.en: Avoid street food in the rains; fresh home food is best.
tips.hinglish: Barsaat mein bahar ka khaana na khaayein; ghar ka taaza khaana sabse achha.

tips.en: Walk carefully on wet floors and muddy paths.
tips.hinglish: Geele farsh aur keechad wale raaston par dhyaan se chalein.

tips.en: Dress in layers and keep your feet warm.
tips.hinglish: Kai parat kapde pehnein aur pair garam rakhein.

tips.en: Avoid travelling early in the morning when the fog is thick.
tips.hinglish: Subah-subah ghane kohre mein safar na karein.

tips.en: If it's too cold outside, walk indoors or on the terrace in the afternoon sun.
tips.hinglish: Bahar zyada thand ho to ghar ke andar ya dopahar ki dhoop mein chhat par tahlein.

tips.en: Keep the room airy if you use an angithi or heater; never sleep with a coal fire in a closed room.
tips.hinglish: Angithi ya heater ho to kamre mein hawa aane dein; band kamre mein koyle ki aag ke saath kabhi na soyein.

tips.en: A gentle evening walk in the fresh air is lovely this season.
tips.hinglish: Is mausam mein shaam ki halki sair bahut achhi lagti hai.

tips.en: Enjoy seasonal fruit like oranges, guavas and ber, washed well.
tips.hinglish: Santra, amrood aur ber jaise mausami phal achhi tarah dhokar khaayein.

tips.en: Pollen can bring sneezes; wash your face and hands after being outside.
tips.hinglish: Phoolon ke paraag se chheenk aa sakti hai; bahar se aakar haath-munh dhoyein.

tips.en: Enjoy the festivals, and take rest breaks between the cooking and cleaning.
tips.hinglish: Tyohaar manaaiye, aur khaana-safaai ke beech aaraam bhi kijiye.

tips.en: Stay away from smoke and loud crackers, and keep a window open for fresh air.
tips.hinglish: Dhuein aur tez pataakhon se door rahein, aur taazi hawa ke liye khidki khuli rakhein.

tips.en: Mithai is lovely in small amounts; fruit and roasted chana make good snacks too.
tips.hinglish: Mithai thodi si achhi hai; phal aur bhuna chana bhi badhiya naashta hain.

text.en: Winter: bajra or makki roti with sarson ka saag gives warmth and iron.
text.hinglish: Sardi: bajre ya makki ki roti aur sarson ka saag garmi aur iron dete hain.

text.en: Kadhi-chawal and dal give comforting protein.
text.hinglish: Kadhi-chawal aur daal se pyaara protein milta hai.

text.en: Lassi and chaach are cooling and good for digestion. Choose fresh, home-made ones.
text.hinglish: Lassi aur chaach thandak dete hain aur pet ke liye achhe hain. Ghar ke taaze wale lein.

text.en: A small handful of roasted chana with a little gur is a lovely iron-rich snack.
text.hinglish: Mutthi bhar bhuna chana aur thoda gur, iron se bhara pyaara naashta hai.

text.en: Eat fruit of the season: guava, orange, banana, papaya (ripe) and more, washed well.
text.hinglish: Mausami phal khaayein: amrood, santra, kela, paka papita, sab dhokar.

text.en: Green leafy sabzi like palak, methi and bathua help with iron.
text.hinglish: Palak, methi, bathua jaisi hari sabziyan iron mein madad karti hain.

text.en: Milk, dahi and paneer give calcium for baby's bones.
text.hinglish: Doodh, dahi aur paneer baby ki haddiyon ke liye calcium dete hain.

text.en: A little ghee is fine, but too much ghee and sweets add extra weight. Keep portions small.
text.hinglish: Thoda ghee theek hai, par zyada ghee aur mithai se vazan badhta hai. Maatra kam rakhein.

text.en: Panjiri and gond laddoos are a family tradition. They are very rich, so ask your doctor how much and when.
text.hinglish: Panjiri aur gond ke laddoo ghar ki parampara hain. Yeh bahut bhaari hote hain, isliye doctor se poochhein kitna aur kab.

text.en: Keep chai to one or two cups a day, and not right with meals (it reduces iron absorption).
text.hinglish: Chai din mein ek-do cup rakhein, aur khaane ke saath nahi (isse iron kam milta hai).

text.en: Have a little nimbu or amla with meals: vitamin C helps your body take in iron.
text.hinglish: Khaane ke saath thoda nimbu ya amla lein: vitamin C iron lene mein madad karta hai.

text.en: Several small meals are easier than three big ones, especially later in pregnancy.
text.hinglish: Teen bade khaane ki jagah kai chhote khaane aasaan rehte hain, khaaskar baad ke mahino mein.

steps.en: Sit comfortably. Breathe in slowly through the nose for 4, out for 4. Feel your belly rise and fall. 5 rounds.
steps.hinglish: Aaraam se baithein. Naak se 4 tak saans lein, 4 tak chhodein. Pet ko uthte-girte mehsoos karein. 5 baar.

steps.en: Sit tall, close your eyes, breathe in, and hum softly like a bee as you breathe out. 5 rounds. Very calming.
steps.hinglish: Seedhe baithein, aankhein band, saans lein, aur chhodte samay bhanwre jaisi halki gunjan karein. 5 baar. Bahut shaanti deta hai.

steps.en: Slowly tilt your head side to side, then gently circle. 5 times each way.
steps.hinglish: Dheere se sir ko idhar-udhar jhukaayein, phir halke se ghumaayein. Har taraf 5 baar.

steps.en: Breathe in through one nostril and out through the other, slowly, without holding the breath. 5 minutes.
steps.hinglish: Ek naak se saans lein, doosre se chhodein, dheere-dheere, saans roke bina. 5 minute.

steps.en: Sit with soles of the feet together and gently move the knees up and down like wings. 1 minute.
steps.hinglish: Pairon ke talve milaakar baithein aur ghutnon ko titli ke pankh jaisa halke se hilaayein. 1 minute.

steps.en: On hands and knees, gently round your back, then softly let it dip. Move with your breath. 5 rounds.
steps.hinglish: Haathon aur ghutnon par aakar peeth ko halke se upar golaai dein, phir dheere se neeche. Saans ke saath. 5 baar.

steps.en: A 15–20 minute easy walk at a pace where you can still talk comfortably.
steps.hinglish: 15–20 minute ki aasaan sair, itni raftaar se ki aaraam se baat kar sakein.

steps.en: Humming breath for 3–5 rounds helps the mind settle at night.
steps.hinglish: 3–5 baar gunjan wali saans raat ko mann shaant karti hai.

steps.en: Lie on your left side with a pillow between your knees and one under your belly. Breathe slowly.
steps.hinglish: Baayein karvat lettein, ghutnon ke beech aur pet ke neeche takiya rakhein. Dheere saans lein.

steps.en: Holding a chair or wall, lower gently into a squat for a few breaths, then rise slowly. Only if comfortable.
steps.hinglish: Kursi ya deewar pakad kar dheere se baithein, kuch saans tak rukein, phir dheere uthein. Sirf aaraam ho to.

steps.en: Sit tall and roll your shoulders backwards slowly, 10 times.
steps.hinglish: Seedhe baithkar kandhon ko peeche ki taraf dheere ghumaayein, 10 baar.
